@@ -0,0 +1,182 @@
+#![forbid(unsafe_code)]
+//! ASCII block chart renderer with dense cap glyphs, today highlight, and cursor scrubber.
+
+use ratatui::Frame;
+use ratatui::layout::{Constraint, Direction, Layout, Rect};
+use ratatui::style::{Color, Modifier, Style};
+use ratatui::text::{Line, Span};
+use ratatui::widgets::{Block, Borders, Paragraph};
+use rotameter_client::types::TimeseriesRow;
+
+use crate::fmt::{dimension_key, format_count, short_bucket_label};
+use crate::state::AppState;
+
+const GLYPHS: [char; 9] = [' ', '▁', '▂', '▃', '▄', '▅', '▆', '▇', '█'];
+
+/// Renders the ASCII block time-series chart, range baseline, cursor readout, and active filter line.
+pub fn render_chart(frame: &mut Frame<'_>, area: Rect, app: &AppState) {
+    let block = Block::default()
+        .borders(Borders::LEFT)
+        .border_style(Style::default().fg(Color::DarkGray));
+    let inner = block.inner(area);
+    frame.render_widget(block, area);
+    if inner.height < 4 || inner.width < 10 {
+        return;
+    }
+
+    let chunks = Layout::default()
+        .direction(Direction::Vertical)
+        .constraints([Constraint::Min(2), Constraint::Length(3)])
+        .split(inner);
+
+    let ts: &[TimeseriesRow] = app.query.as_ref().map_or(&[], |q| q.timeseries.as_slice());
+    let bars_lines = build_bar_lines(
+        ts,
+        app.scrub_idx,
+        usize::from(chunks[0].width),
+        usize::from(chunks[0].height),
+    );
+    frame.render_widget(Paragraph::new(bars_lines), chunks[0]);
+    frame.render_widget(
+        Paragraph::new(build_footer_lines(app, inner.width)),
+        chunks[1],
+    );
+}
+
+fn build_bar_lines(
+    ts: &[TimeseriesRow],
+    scrub_idx: Option<usize>,
+    width: usize,
+    height: usize,
+) -> Vec<Line<'static>> {
+    if ts.is_empty() || height == 0 || width == 0 {
+        return vec![Line::from(Span::styled(
+            "no time-series data",
+            Style::default().fg(Color::DarkGray),
+        ))];
+    }
+
+    let max_bars = width.div_ceil(2);
+    let start_idx = ts.len().saturating_sub(max_bars);
+    let slice = &ts[start_idx..];
+    let peak = slice.iter().map(|b| b.visitors.max(1)).max().unwrap_or(1);
+    let total_levels = height * 8;
+    let mut rows = Vec::with_capacity(height);
+
+    for row_idx in 0..height {
+        let level_floor = (height - 1 - row_idx) * 8;
+        let mut spans = Vec::with_capacity(slice.len() * 2);
+        for (offset, b) in slice.iter().enumerate() {
+            if offset > 0 {
+                spans.push(Span::raw(" "));
+            }
+            let global_idx = start_idx + offset;
+            let fill =
+                usize::try_from((b.visitors * u64::try_from(total_levels).unwrap_or(1)) / peak)
+                    .unwrap_or(total_levels);
+            let ch = cell_glyph(fill, level_floor, row_idx == 0 && b.visitors == peak);
+            let style = bar_style(global_idx, ts.len() - 1, scrub_idx);
+            spans.push(Span::styled(ch.to_string(), style));
+        }
+        rows.push(Line::from(spans));
+    }
+    rows
+}
+
+fn cell_glyph(fill: usize, level_floor: usize, is_peak_top: bool) -> char {
+    if fill <= level_floor {
+        return ' ';
+    }
+    let rem = fill - level_floor;
+    if rem >= 8 {
+        '█'
+    } else if is_peak_top && rem == 7 {
+        '▀'
+    } else {
+        GLYPHS[rem]
+    }
+}
+
+fn bar_style(idx: usize, last_idx: usize, scrub_idx: Option<usize>) -> Style {
+    if scrub_idx == Some(idx) {
+        Style::default()
+            .fg(Color::Yellow)
+            .add_modifier(Modifier::BOLD | Modifier::REVERSED)
+    } else if idx == last_idx {
+        Style::default()
+            .fg(Color::Cyan)
+            .add_modifier(Modifier::BOLD)
+    } else {
+        Style::default().fg(Color::Green)
+    }
+}
+
+fn build_footer_lines(app: &AppState, width: u16) -> Vec<Line<'static>> {
+    let axis = build_axis_line(app, usize::from(width));
+    let cursor = if let Some(b) = app.active_bucket() {
+        let lbl = short_bucket_label(&b.bucket, app.range);
+        let tag = if app.scrub_idx.is_some() {
+            "CURSOR"
+        } else {
+            "LATEST"
+        };
+        Line::from(Span::styled(
+            format!(
+                "{tag}: {lbl} · {} VISITORS · {} VIEWS",
+                format_count(b.visitors),
+                format_count(b.pageviews)
+            ),
+            Style::default().fg(Color::Yellow),
+        ))
+    } else {
+        Line::from(Span::styled(
+            "CURSOR: --",
+            Style::default().fg(Color::DarkGray),
+        ))
+    };
+
+    let filter_line = if app.filters.is_empty() {
+        Line::from(Span::styled(
+            "ACTIVE FILTER: none",
+            Style::default().fg(Color::DarkGray),
+        ))
+    } else {
+        let tags: Vec<String> = app
+            .filters
+            .iter()
+            .map(|f| {
+                let k = dimension_key(f.dimension);
+                let v = match &f.value {
+                    rotameter_client::types::FilterValue::Scalar(s) => s.clone(),
+                    rotameter_client::types::FilterValue::List(xs) => xs.join(","),
+                };
+                format!("[{k}={v}]")
+            })
+            .collect();
+        Line::from(Span::styled(
+            format!("ACTIVE FILTER: {} (Esc to clear)", tags.join(" ")),
+            Style::default().fg(Color::Magenta),
+        ))
+    };
+
+    vec![axis, cursor, filter_line]
+}
+
+fn build_axis_line(app: &AppState, width: usize) -> Line<'static> {
+    let ts: &[TimeseriesRow] = app.query.as_ref().map_or(&[], |q| q.timeseries.as_slice());
+    let (Some(first), Some(last)) = (ts.first(), ts.last()) else {
+        return Line::from("");
+    };
+    let left = short_bucket_label(&first.bucket, app.range);
+    let end_short = last
+        .bucket
+        .get(5..10)
+        .unwrap_or(&last.bucket)
+        .replace('-', ".");
+    let right = format!("TODAY ({end_short})");
+    let fill = width.saturating_sub(left.len() + right.len() + 3).max(2);
+    Line::from(Span::styled(
+        format!("{left} {}▶ {right}", "─".repeat(fill)),
+        Style::default().fg(Color::DarkGray),
+    ))
+}

+#![forbid(unsafe_code)]
+//! Number, duration, delta, timestamp, and dimension-key formatting helpers.
+
+use rotameter_client::types::{Dimension, RangePreset};
+
+/// Formats an unsigned integer with US-style comma grouping (`1,842`).
+pub fn format_count(n: u64) -> String {
+    let raw = n.to_string();
+    let mut out = String::with_capacity(raw.len() + raw.len() / 3);
+    for (idx, ch) in raw.chars().rev().enumerate() {
+        if idx > 0 && idx % 3 == 0 {
+            out.push(',');
+        }
+        out.push(ch);
+    }
+    out.chars().rev().collect()
+}
+
+/// Formats milliseconds as `MMmSSs`.
+pub fn format_duration(ms: u64) -> String {
+    let secs = ms / 1_000;
+    format!("{:02}m{:02}s", secs / 60, secs % 60)
+}
+
+/// Formats percentage delta (`+22%`, `-3%`, `--`).
+pub fn format_delta(cur: f64, prev: f64) -> String {
+    if prev.abs() <= f64::EPSILON {
+        return "--".to_string();
+    }
+    let pct = ((cur - prev) / prev) * 100.0;
+    format!("{pct:+.0}%")
+}
+
+/// Formats an ISO-8601 timestamp into compact date/hour readout labels.
+pub fn short_bucket_label(iso: &str, range: RangePreset) -> String {
+    let date = iso.get(0..10).unwrap_or(iso).replace('-', ".");
+    if range == RangePreset::Hours24
+        && let Some(hm) = iso.get(11..16)
+    {
+        return format!("{} {hm}", date.get(5..10).unwrap_or(&date));
+    }
+    date
+}
+
+/// Returns the canonical wire key string for a [`Dimension`].
+pub const fn dimension_key(dim: Dimension) -> &'static str {
+    match dim {
+        Dimension::Path => "path",
+        Dimension::EntryPage => "entry_page",
+        Dimension::ExitPage => "exit_page",
+        Dimension::Source => "source",
+        Dimension::Referrer => "referrer",
+        Dimension::Channel => "channel",
+        Dimension::Country => "country",
+        Dimension::Region => "region",
+        Dimension::Browser => "browser",
+        Dimension::Os => "os",
+        Dimension::Device => "device",
+        Dimension::Viewport => "viewport",
+        Dimension::EventName => "event_name",
+        Dimension::UtmSource => "utm_source",
+        Dimension::UtmMedium => "utm_medium",
+        Dimension::UtmCampaign => "utm_campaign",
+    }
+}

+#![forbid(unsafe_code)]
+//! Keyboard event dispatcher for range hotkeys, scrubbing, breakdown drill-down, and overlays.
+
+use crossterm::event::{KeyCode, KeyEvent, KeyEventKind, KeyModifiers};
+use rotameter_client::types::{FilterOp, FilterValue, QueryFilter, RangePreset, SiteRef};
+
+use crate::state::AppState;
+
+/// Action requested by handling a single terminal key event.
+#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]
+pub enum KeyAction {
+    /// UI-only state change; no network refresh needed.
+    None,
+    /// State changed requiring a background query refresh.
+    Refresh,
+    /// User requested clean exit.
+    Quit,
+}
+
+/// Applies one terminal key press to [`AppState`] and returns the resulting [`KeyAction`].
+pub fn handle_key_event(app: &mut AppState, key: KeyEvent) -> KeyAction {
+    if key.kind != KeyEventKind::Press {
+        return KeyAction::None;
+    }
+    if key.modifiers.contains(KeyModifiers::CONTROL) && key.code == KeyCode::Char('c') {
+        app.should_quit = true;
+        return KeyAction::Quit;
+    }
+    if key.code == KeyCode::Char('q') {
+        app.should_quit = true;
+        return KeyAction::Quit;
+    }
+    if key.code == KeyCode::Char('?') {
+        app.help_open = !app.help_open;
+        app.site_switcher_open = false;
+        return KeyAction::None;
+    }
+    if app.help_open && matches!(key.code, KeyCode::Esc | KeyCode::Enter) {
+        app.help_open = false;
+        return KeyAction::None;
+    }
+    if app.site_switcher_open {
+        return handle_site_switcher_key(app, key.code);
+    }
+    handle_dashboard_key(app, key.code)
+}
+
+fn handle_site_switcher_key(app: &mut AppState, code: KeyCode) -> KeyAction {
+    let count = app.sites.len();
+    match code {
+        KeyCode::Esc | KeyCode::Char('s') => app.site_switcher_open = false,
+        KeyCode::Up | KeyCode::Char('k') if app.site_picker_idx > 0 => app.site_picker_idx -= 1,
+        KeyCode::Down | KeyCode::Char('j') if count > 0 && app.site_picker_idx + 1 < count => {
+            app.site_picker_idx += 1;
+        }
+        KeyCode::Enter if count > 0 => {
+            if let Some(slug) = app.sites.get(app.site_picker_idx).cloned() {
+                app.active_site = SiteRef::Slug(slug);
+                app.site_switcher_open = false;
+                app.filters.clear();
+                app.scrub_idx = None;
+                app.selected_row = 0;
+                app.loading = true;
+                return KeyAction::Refresh;
+            }
+        }
+        _ => {}
+    }
+    KeyAction::None
+}
+
+fn handle_dashboard_key(app: &mut AppState, code: KeyCode) -> KeyAction {
+    match code {
+        KeyCode::Char('1') => return set_range(app, RangePreset::Hours24),
+        KeyCode::Char('2') => return set_range(app, RangePreset::Days7),
+        KeyCode::Char('3') => return set_range(app, RangePreset::Days30),
+        KeyCode::Char('4') => return set_range(app, RangePreset::Months12),
+        KeyCode::Char('5') => return set_range(app, RangePreset::All),
+        KeyCode::Left | KeyCode::Char('h') => scrub_horizontal(app, -1),
+        KeyCode::Right | KeyCode::Char('l') => scrub_horizontal(app, 1),
+        KeyCode::Up | KeyCode::Char('k') if app.selected_row > 0 => app.selected_row -= 1,
+        KeyCode::Down | KeyCode::Char('j') => move_row_down(app),
+        KeyCode::Tab => {
+            app.tab = app.tab.next();
+            app.selected_row = 0;
+            app.loading = true;
+            return KeyAction::Refresh;
+        }
+        KeyCode::BackTab => {
+            app.tab = app.tab.prev();
+            app.selected_row = 0;
+            app.loading = true;
+            return KeyAction::Refresh;
+        }
+        KeyCode::Enter => return push_row_filter(app),
+        KeyCode::Esc => {
+            if app.filters.pop().is_some() {
+                app.selected_row = 0;
+                app.loading = true;
+                return KeyAction::Refresh;
+            }
+            app.scrub_idx = None;
+        }
+        KeyCode::Char('s') => open_site_switcher(app),
+        KeyCode::Char('r') => {
+            app.loading = true;
+            return KeyAction::Refresh;
+        }
+        _ => {}
+    }
+    KeyAction::None
+}

task.title: Streaming log receiver for rotameter import (Nginx, Caddy, Apache)

Replace whole-file fs::read_to_string in rotameter import with line-by-line streaming (BufRead) supporting --stdin / - (Apache CustomLog "|..." piped logs), --unix-socket <path> (syslog/NDJSON for Nginx access_log syslog:server=unix:... and Caddy output net unix//... with zero raw IPs written to disk), and --follow (with log-rotation/inode handling).

task.title: 0.3.0: /v1/capabilities, /v1/auth/* (local admin + OIDC + CF Access), and feature-gated ui asset serving (--ui=on|off, --ui-dir)
task.description:
Implement 0.3.0 Web UI backend capabilities, operator auth, and static asset serving per docs/SPEC-UI.md, docs/SPEC-API.md, and ADR-0009:
1. Add GET /v1/capabilities returning snake_case { topology, node_role, features, auth_methods, endpoints } and optional cluster metadata fields (watermark_ts, partial_nodes, served_by_node) on POST /v1/query meta.
2. Add /v1/auth/* endpoints (local admin login/logout/me + OIDC start/callback) issuing HttpOnly; SameSite=Lax; Secure operator session cookies with CSRF protection, plus optional Cloudflare Access and Bearer passthrough. Keep visitor collection strictly cookieless.
3. Add Cargo feature ui in rotameter-server and rotameter-cli to embed pre-compressed ui/dist/ (<= 1.5 MB) behind --ui=on|off (default off) and --ui-dir <path> runtime override, enforcing self_site loop guards when self-dogfooding is enabled.
acceptance_criteria: GET /v1/capabilities returns snake_case topology, node_role, features, auth_methods, and endpoints

POST /v1/auth/login, POST /v1/auth/logout, GET /v1/auth/me, GET /v1/auth/oidc/start, and GET /v1/auth/oidc/callback issue HttpOnly SameSite=Lax Secure session cookies with CSRF protection while keeping visitor collection 100% cookieless
CF Access header/JWT trust and Bearer token passthrough work alongside operator sessions
Cargo feature ui embeds pre-compressed ui/dist/ (<= 1.5 MB) gated behind --ui=on|off (default off) and --ui-dir <path> override
Headless default builds (without ui feature) compile cleanly without Bun or UI asset overhead

Canonical specification: `docs/SPEC-UI.md`, `DESIGN.md`, `docs/SPEC-API.md` (§7), and `ADR-0009`.

## Implementation Phases
1. **Backend & Auth (`RM-37`):** `GET /v1/capabilities`, optional cluster fields on `POST /v1/query` `meta`, `/v1/auth/*` (`HttpOnly; SameSite=Lax; Secure` sessions + CSRF, local admin, OIDC, CF Access / Bearer passthrough), and Cargo feature `ui` embedded static asset serving (`--ui=on|off`, default `off`, plus `--ui-dir`).
2. **Frontend Foundation (`RM-38`):** Bun workspace monorepo under `ui/` (`apps/web`, `@rotameter/ui`, `@rotameter/plugin-sdk`), `tokens.css` (Drafting Vellum / Avionics Night / 3 densities), `@base-ui/react` + Base UI shadcn escape hatch, TanStack Router/Query URL state, capability handshake, and auth gate.
3. **Core Analytics Plugins (`RM-39`):** Lazy-loaded `@rotameter/plugin-overview` (`uPlot` + KPI strip), `@rotameter/plugin-breakdowns` (TanStack Table + Virtual reading `--density-table-row-h` + CSV/Parquet export), and `@rotameter/plugin-realtime` (5m active + 30m pulse).

- Strictly `/v1/*` and `snake_case` JSON; visitor collection (`collect.js`, `pixel.gif`, `/v1/events`) remains 100% cookieless.

plan.design_markdown:
# RM-37 Design Blueprint: Backend Capabilities, Auth & Feature-Gated UI Serving

Specs: `docs/SPEC-UI.md` (§1, §4), `docs/SPEC-API.md` (§7), `ADR-0009`.

## 1. `GET /v1/capabilities` & `POST /v1/query` Cluster Metadata
- Add unauthenticated `GET /v1/capabilities` returning `snake_case`:
  `{ topology: "single", node_role: "all"|"ingest"|"query", features: { ui, arrow_export, oidc, streams }, auth_methods: [...], endpoints: { query: "/v1", stream: "/v1" } }`.
- Extend `QueryMeta` (`POST /v1/query` `meta`) with optional `watermark_ts: Option<String>`, `partial_nodes: Option<u32>`, and `served_by_node: Option<String>` (`skip_serializing_if = "Option::is_none"`).

## 2. Operator Auth (`/v1/auth/*`)
- Endpoints: `POST /v1/auth/login`, `POST /v1/auth/logout`, `GET /v1/auth/me`, `GET /v1/auth/oidc/start`, `GET /v1/auth/oidc/callback`.
- Local admin credentials (hashed password / bootstrap config) and OIDC/SSO issue `HttpOnly; SameSite=Lax; Secure` (when HTTPS/public-url is https) session cookies with CSRF double-submit or Origin/Sec-Fetch-Site verification on mutating routes.
- Accept operator sessions, trusted Cloudflare Access headers/JWT, or `rm_adm_`/`rm_rd_` Bearer tokens on query/admin routes.
- **Invariant:** Collection routes (`/v1/collect.js`, `/v1/pixel.gif`, `/v1/events`) never read or set cookies.

## 3. Feature-Gated Static Asset Serving
- Add Cargo feature `ui` in `rotameter-server` and `rotameter-cli` embedding pre-compressed `ui/dist/` (`<= 1.5 MB` compressed) via `include_dir` or `rust-embed` (keeping `#![forbid(unsafe_code)]`).
- CLI/env/config: `--ui=on|off` (default `off`), `--ui-dir <path>` runtime override (works even without `ui` Cargo feature), SPA fallback to `index.html` for non-`/v1/*` routes, immutable cache headers for hashed `/assets/*`, `no-cache` for `index.html`.
- Keep all `.rs` files `< 250` lines (split `auth_session.rs`, `handlers/auth.rs`, `handlers/capabilities.rs`, `ui_assets.rs`).

# RM-38 Design Blueprint: Bun Workspace Monorepo & Host Shell

Specs: `docs/SPEC-UI.md` (§1, §3, §4, §5, §6), `DESIGN.md`, `ADR-0009`.

## 1. Bun Workspace Layout (`ui/`)
- `ui/package.json` (`"workspaces": ["apps/*", "packages/*"]`), `ui/tsconfig.base.json` (`"strict": true`).
- `ui/packages/ui` (`@rotameter/ui`): `tokens.css` (exact Drafting Vellum light, Avionics Night dark, and compact/standard/comfortable density tokens), Tailwind v4 CSS entry, `@base-ui/react` wrapped primitives (`Button`, `Input`, `Select`, `Popover`, `Dialog`, `Drawer`, `Tabs`, `Tooltip`, `InstrumentFrame`), and `components.json` for Base UI-backed shadcn escape hatch.
- `ui/packages/plugin-sdk` (`@rotameter/plugin-sdk`): `PluginManifest` (routes, nav_items, dashboard_panels, visualizations, inspector_tabs, row_actions, query_transforms, exporters, scopes), `useDashboardQuery()`, `updateQuery()`, `ChartHost` (deferred WebGL seam), `useCapabilities()`, and typed `/v1/*` fetch client with `AbortSignal` + configurable `query_base_url`/`stream_base_url`.
- `ui/apps/web`: Vite + React + TypeScript host compiling to static `ui/dist/`.

## 2. State, Routing & Boot Handshake
- Boot calls `GET /v1/capabilities`; if `node_role === "ingest"`, gate query routes and route to Node Role Telemetry view.
- Auth gate calls `GET /v1/auth/me` and renders login/OIDC screen when unauthenticated.
- `@tanstack/react-router` validates canonical search params (`/sites/:siteId/overview?range=7d&interval=1h&compare=prev&f=country:US,path:/blog/*`) with `push` for discrete pivots and `replace` for continuous adjustments.
- `@tanstack/react-query` keys off validated URL query (`staleTime` 30–60s historical, `AbortSignal` wired).
- `localStorage` persists `theme`, `density`, sidebar collapse, and stream pause state.
- Compact header telemetry strip renders `SINGLE-NODE · <query_ms>ms` (extensible for cluster lag / partial shard).

- Lazy-loaded Vite chunk registered via `PluginManifest` (`scopes: ["read:aggregates"]`).
- Renders 6-metric CAD KPI instrument strip (`visitors`, `pageviews`, `visits`, `views_per_visit`, `bounce_rate`, `avg_visit_duration_ms`) with period comparison deltas and AAA `>= 7:1` primary numeral contrast in tabular monospace.
- Renders `uPlot` time-series inside `ChartHost` (zero ECharts, zero WebGL): reads `--series-*` and `--border-hairline` from CSS tokens, combines colorblind-safe hues with distinct stroke dash patterns (`solid`, `6 3`, `2 2`) or markers, supports brush zoom (`replace` history), and provides a keyboard-accessible tabular data fallback view.

## 2. `@rotameter/plugin-breakdowns`
- Tabs for Pages (`path`), Referrers (`source` / `channel`), UTM/Cohorts (`utm_*`), and Devices/Geo (`country`, `region`, `browser`, `os`, `device`).
- Uses `@tanstack/react-table` + `@tanstack/react-virtual` with owned HTML/SVG proportion bars (no ECharts).
- Virtualizer `estimateSize` reads `--density-table-row-h` dynamically via `getComputedStyle` + `MutationObserver` on `data-density` for `O(1)` scroll offset math.
- Row click pushes filter pills via `updateQuery()` (never `window.location`).
- Includes CSV (`POST /v1/query` `format: "csv"`) and Parquet export actions (gated by `capabilities.features.arrow_export`).

## 3. `@rotameter/plugin-realtime`
- Polls `GET /v1/sites/{site}/realtime` via TanStack Query (`staleTime` 5–15s, `AbortSignal`).
- Displays 5-minute active visitor readout, active pages table, and 30-minute minute-by-minute pulse (`uPlot` or owned SVG bar strip with tabular fallback).

# RM-40 Design Blueprint: Admin & Cluster Plugins + WCAG 2.2 AA & Bundle Gates

Specs: `docs/SPEC-UI.md` (§1, §4, §6, §7), `AGENTS.md` (§3.6), `ADR-0009`.

## 1. `@rotameter/plugin-admin`
- Lazy-loaded workspace plugin (`scopes: ["admin:sites", "admin:keys"]`).
- Site management over `/v1/admin/sites*`: create/edit `slug`, `display_name`, `timezone`, `salt_rotation`, `respect_gpc`, `allowed_origins`, `allowed_query_keys`, `raw_retention_days`, plus confirmed delete (`?confirm=true`) and `collect.js` snippet generator.
- API key management over `/v1/admin/keys*`: mint scoped keys (`ingest`, `read`, `admin`) with one-time plaintext reveal/copy modal, list metadata, and revoke keys.

## 2. `@rotameter/plugin-cluster`
- Single-node health & role status panel over `GET /v1/health` + `GET /v1/capabilities` (queue depth `%`, storage readiness, schema version, uptime, active `node_role`).
- Acts as the default landing view when `node_role === "ingest"` (Node Role Telemetry status view).
- Keeps clean extension seam for `0.5.0` (`RM-22`) multinode roster grid when `topology === "cluster"`.

## 3. Automated Quality, Lint & Bundle-Budget Gates
- Add lint rules banning hardcoded hex/rgb colors, blurred box-shadows, hardcoded pixel row heights, raw `window.location` in `packages/plugin-*`, ECharts in `0.3.0`, and WebGL deps.
- Add automated WCAG 2.2 AA verification (token contrast assertions, `:focus-visible` ring, `>= 24×24px` target sizes in `compact` density, chart tabular fallback accessibility).
- Add `scripts/check-ui-budget.sh` asserting initial load `<= 250 KB` gzip and total compressed embedded `ui/dist/` `<= 1.5 MB`.

# RM-18 Execution Blueprint: `0.3.0` Web UI

Canonical specification: `docs/SPEC-UI.md`, `docs/SPEC-API.md` (§7), and `ADR-0009`.

## Implementation Phases
1. **Backend & Auth (`RM-37`):** `GET /v1/capabilities`, optional cluster fields on `POST /v1/query` `meta`, `/v1/auth/*` (`HttpOnly; SameSite=Lax; Secure` sessions + CSRF, local admin, OIDC, CF Access / Bearer passthrough), and Cargo feature `ui` embedded static asset serving (`--ui=on|off`, default `off`, plus `--ui-dir`).
2. **Frontend Foundation (`RM-38`):** Bun workspace monorepo under `ui/` (`apps/web`, `@rotameter/ui`, `@rotameter/plugin-sdk`), `tokens.css` (Drafting Vellum / Avionics Night / 3 densities), `@base-ui/react` + Base UI shadcn escape hatch, TanStack Router/Query URL state, capability handshake, and auth gate.
3. **Core Analytics Plugins (`RM-39`):** Lazy-loaded `@rotameter/plugin-overview` (`uPlot` + KPI strip), `@rotameter/plugin-breakdowns` (TanStack Table + Virtual reading `--density-table-row-h` + CSV/Parquet export), and `@rotameter/plugin-realtime` (5m active + 30m pulse).
4. **Ops/Admin Plugins & Gates (`RM-40`):** `@rotameter/plugin-admin` (sites & API keys), `@rotameter/plugin-cluster` (single-node health & ingest-only role status), WCAG 2.2 AA verification, and bundle-size gates (`<= 250 KB` gzip initial load, `<= 1.5 MB` embedded `ui/dist/`).

## Non-Negotiable Invariants
- Strictly `/v1/*` and `snake_case` JSON; visitor collection (`collect.js`, `pixel.gif`, `/v1/events`) remains 100% cookieless.
- Zero hardcoded colors, drop-shadows, or pixel row heights; zero ECharts in `0.3.0`; zero WebGL dependencies.
- Local `self_site` dogfooding respects `--no-self-site` and never phones home.

# RM-38 Design Blueprint: Bun Workspace Monorepo & Host Shell

Specs: `docs/SPEC-UI.md` (§1, §3, §4, §5, §6), `ADR-0009`.

## 1. Bun Workspace Layout (`ui/`)
- `ui/package.json` (`"workspaces": ["apps/*", "packages/*"]`), `ui/tsconfig.base.json` (`"strict": true`).
- `ui/packages/ui` (`@rotameter/ui`): `tokens.css` (exact Drafting Vellum light, Avionics Night dark, and compact/standard/comfortable density tokens), Tailwind v4 CSS entry, `@base-ui/react` wrapped primitives (`Button`, `Input`, `Select`, `Popover`, `Dialog`, `Drawer`, `Tabs`, `Tooltip`, `InstrumentFrame`), and `components.json` for Base UI-backed shadcn escape hatch.
- `ui/packages/plugin-sdk` (`@rotameter/plugin-sdk`): `PluginManifest` (routes, nav_items, dashboard_panels, visualizations, inspector_tabs, row_actions, query_transforms, exporters, scopes), `useDashboardQuery()`, `updateQuery()`, `ChartHost` (deferred WebGL seam), `useCapabilities()`, and typed `/v1/*` fetch client with `AbortSignal` + configurable `query_base_url`/`stream_base_url`.
- `ui/apps/web`: Vite + React + TypeScript host compiling to static `ui/dist/`.

## 2. State, Routing & Boot Handshake
- Boot calls `GET /v1/capabilities`; if `node_role === "ingest"`, gate query routes and route to Node Role Telemetry view.
- Auth gate calls `GET /v1/auth/me` and renders login/OIDC screen when unauthenticated.
- `@tanstack/react-router` validates canonical search params (`/sites/:siteId/overview?range=7d&interval=1h&compare=prev&f=country:US,path:/blog/*`) with `push` for discrete pivots and `replace` for continuous adjustments.
- `@tanstack/react-query` keys off validated URL query (`staleTime` 30–60s historical, `AbortSignal` wired).
- `localStorage` persists `theme`, `density`, sidebar collapse, and stream pause state.
- Compact header telemetry strip renders `SINGLE-NODE · <query_ms>ms` (extensible for cluster lag / partial shard).

plan.summary: Implement /v1/capabilities, /v1/auth/* operator auth, and feature-gated static UI serving in rotameter-server and rotameter-cli.
plan.design_markdown:
# RM-37 Design Blueprint: Backend Capabilities, Auth & Feature-Gated UI Serving

Specs: `docs/SPEC-UI.md` (§1, §4), `docs/SPEC-API.md` (§7), `ADR-0009`.

## 1. `GET /v1/capabilities` & `POST /v1/query` Cluster Metadata
- Add unauthenticated `GET /v1/capabilities` returning `snake_case`:
  `{ topology: "single", node_role: "all"|"ingest"|"query", features: { ui, arrow_export, oidc, streams }, auth_methods: [...], endpoints: { query: "/v1", stream: "/v1" } }`.
- Extend `QueryMeta` (`POST /v1/query` `meta`) with optional `watermark_ts: Option<String>`, `partial_nodes: Option<u32>`, and `served_by_node: Option<String>` (`skip_serializing_if = "Option::is_none"`).

## 2. Operator Auth (`/v1/auth/*`)
- Endpoints: `POST /v1/auth/login`, `POST /v1/auth/logout`, `GET /v1/auth/me`, `GET /v1/auth/oidc/start`, `GET /v1/auth/oidc/callback`.
- Local admin credentials (hashed password / bootstrap config) and OIDC/SSO issue `HttpOnly; SameSite=Lax; Secure` (when HTTPS/public-url is https) session cookies with CSRF double-submit or Origin/Sec-Fetch-Site verification on mutating routes.
- Accept operator sessions, trusted Cloudflare Access headers/JWT, or `rm_adm_`/`rm_rd_` Bearer tokens on query/admin routes.
- **Invariant:** Collection routes (`/v1/collect.js`, `/v1/pixel.gif`, `/v1/events`) never read or set cookies.

## 3. Feature-Gated Static Asset Serving
- Add Cargo feature `ui` in `rotameter-server` and `rotameter-cli` embedding pre-compressed `ui/dist/` (`<= 1.5 MB` compressed) via `include_dir` or `rust-embed` (keeping `#![forbid(unsafe_code)]`).
- CLI/env/config: `--ui=on|off` (default `off`), `--ui-dir <path>` runtime override (works even without `ui` Cargo feature), SPA fallback to `index.html` for non-`/v1/*` routes, immutable cache headers for hashed `/assets/*`, `no-cache` for `index.html`.
- Keep all `.rs` files `< 250` lines (split `auth_session.rs`, `handlers/auth.rs`, `handlers/capabilities.rs`, `ui_assets.rs`).

# RM-38 Design Blueprint: Bun Workspace Monorepo & Host Shell

Specs: `docs/SPEC-UI.md` (§1, §3, §4, §5, §6), `ADR-0009`.

## 1. Bun Workspace Layout (`ui/`)
- `ui/package.json` (`"workspaces": ["apps/*", "packages/*"]`), `ui/tsconfig.base.json` (`"strict": true`).
- `ui/packages/ui` (`@rotameter/ui`): `tokens.css` (exact Drafting Vellum light, Avionics Night dark, and compact/standard/comfortable density tokens), Tailwind v4 CSS entry, `@base-ui/react` wrapped primitives (`Button`, `Input`, `Select`, `Popover`, `Dialog`, `Drawer`, `Tabs`, `Tooltip`, `InstrumentFrame`), and `components.json` for Base UI-backed shadcn escape hatch.
- `ui/packages/plugin-sdk` (`@rotameter/plugin-sdk`): `PluginManifest` (routes, nav_items, dashboard_panels, visualizations, inspector_tabs, row_actions, query_transforms, exporters, scopes), `useDashboardQuery()`, `updateQuery()`, `ChartHost` (deferred WebGL seam), `useCapabilities()`, and typed `/v1/*` fetch client with `AbortSignal` + configurable `query_base_url`/`stream_base_url`.
- `ui/apps/web`: Vite + React + TypeScript host compiling to static `ui/dist/`.

## 2. State, Routing & Boot Handshake
- Boot calls `GET /v1/capabilities`; if `node_role === "ingest"`, gate query routes and route to Node Role Telemetry view.
- Auth gate calls `GET /v1/auth/me` and renders login/OIDC screen when unauthenticated.
- `@tanstack/react-router` validates canonical search params (`/sites/:siteId/overview?range=7d&interval=1h&compare=prev&f=country:US,path:/blog/*`) with `push` for discrete pivots and `replace` for continuous adjustments.
- `@tanstack/react-query` keys off validated URL query (`staleTime` 30–60s historical, `AbortSignal` wired).
- `localStorage` persists `theme`, `density`, sidebar collapse, and stream pause state.
- Compact header telemetry strip renders `SINGLE-NODE · <query_ms>ms` (extensible for cluster lag / partial shard).

Specs: `docs/SPEC-UI.md` (§1, §4), `docs/SPEC-API.md` (§7), `ADR-0009`.

## 1. `GET /v1/capabilities` & `POST /v1/query` Cluster Metadata
- Add unauthenticated `GET /v1/capabilities` returning `snake_case`:
  `{ topology: "single", node_role: "all"|"ingest"|"query", features: { ui, arrow_export, oidc, streams }, auth_methods: [...], endpoints: { query: "/v1", stream: "/v1" } }`.
- Extend `QueryMeta` (`POST /v1/query` `meta`) with optional `watermark_ts: Option<String>`, `partial_nodes: Option<u32>`, and `served_by_node: Option<String>` (`skip_serializing_if = "Option::is_none"`).

## 2. Operator Auth (`/v1/auth/*`)
- Endpoints: `POST /v1/auth/login`, `POST /v1/auth/logout`, `GET /v1/auth/me`, `GET /v1/auth/oidc/start`, `GET /v1/auth/oidc/callback`.
- Local admin credentials (hashed password / bootstrap config) and OIDC/SSO issue `HttpOnly; SameSite=Lax; Secure` (when HTTPS/public-url is https) session cookies with CSRF double-submit or Origin/Sec-Fetch-Site verification on mutating routes.
- Accept operator sessions, trusted Cloudflare Access headers/JWT, or `rm_adm_`/`rm_rd_` Bearer tokens on query/admin routes.
- **Invariant:** Collection routes (`/v1/collect.js`, `/v1/pixel.gif`, `/v1/events`) never read or set cookies.

## 3. Feature-Gated Static Asset Serving
- Add Cargo feature `ui` in `rotameter-server` and `rotameter-cli` embedding pre-compressed `ui/dist/` (`<= 1.5 MB` compressed) via `include_dir` or `rust-embed` (keeping `#![forbid(unsafe_code)]`).
- CLI/env/config: `--ui=on|off` (default `off`), `--ui-dir <path>` runtime override (works even without `ui` Cargo feature), SPA fallback to `index.html` for non-`/v1/*` routes, immutable cache headers for hashed `/assets/*`, `no-cache` for `index.html`.
- Keep all `.rs` files `< 250` lines (split `auth_session.rs`, `handlers/auth.rs`, `handlers/capabilities.rs`, `ui_assets.rs`).
